content:
alex: Quick thread: reproducible bug in rerank batch helper where retries produce reordered results and SDK maps by index. Seen in Node v0.10 and Python 1.3.

alex: Repro (Node):
```js
const ids = docs.map((d,i)=>d.id||`doc${i}`);
const vectors = docs.map(d=>padTo(d.vec, 1536));
await client.rerank.batch({ model: 'sim-rerank-1536', body: { ids, vectors } });
```

alex: When a shard timeout triggers a retry the runtime may return a reordered `ids` array (server side fallback). Node helper assumed stable index mapping and applied scores by position, so top-k got scrambled.

rina: Two issues: 1) retry path was dropping x-idempotency-key so server treated retry as new request; 2) helper was not matching response by returned ids.

sam: Also saw padTo sometimes inserting `null` for short vectors which the runtime coerced to 0 -> causes mixed shard errors and more fallbacks. We should validate vectors before send.

alex: Proposed fixes: attach persistent `x-idempotency-key` per batch (survive retries), change client to build map from response `ids` to scores and apply to original docs, and add input validation (length, numeric, no null/NaN) with clear error messages like: "bad_vector: id=doc17 len=1510 expected=1536".

qa-bot: Tasks created: DX-4421 (SDK idempotency/retry), DX-4422 (batch helper id->score mapping unit tests), DX-4423 (sampleapp quickstart note + CI burst test).

rina: I'll draft small Node patch to persist idempotency header and update mapping logic. Sam can add pre-send validator in shared helper.

alex: Thanks — this will fix customer reports where ranks didn't match documents.
